# Kumar & Swamy Architects

> Kumar & Swamy Architects is a multidisciplinary architecture practice in Bangalore, founded 1969 — from schools, campuses and institutions to infrastructure, healthcare, sports, residential, resorts, interiors and product design across India. 60+ institutions built in three generations.

Established 1969 in Bangalore, India. Architecture, masterplanning and interiors, best known for schools and institutional campuses.

## Services

- [Institutional & Campus Design](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/services#institutional-campus): Schools, universities and civic institutions — from a single block to a full multi-phase campus masterplan.
- [Masterplanning](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/services#masterplanning): Long-horizon planning that anticipates growth, climate and culture. We think in decades, not quarters.
- [Infrastructure](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/services#infrastructure): Civic and public infrastructure designed for the scale, movement and pace of a growing city.
- [Sports Facilities](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/services#sports-facilities): Stadiums, academies and training facilities — designed for athletes, spectators and the city alike.
- [Healthcare](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/services#healthcare): Hospitals and clinical interiors where clarity, calm and operational efficiency share the brief equally.
- [Residential & Hospitality](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/services#residential-hospitality): Homes, resorts and hospitality that balance comfort, place and craft over the long life of a building.
- [Interiors](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/services#interiors): The inside of a building: libraries, classrooms, workplaces and public rooms tuned for real daily use.
- [Product Design](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/services#product-design): Furniture, fittings and bespoke elements — down to the details that carry the identity of a place.

## Journal

- [Learning Architecture](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/learning-architecture): Harsha Shivakumar, Sep 30, 2026. Should architecture schools start with engineering drawing, or with people? A case for spending the first years on the human mind and its relationship with space.
- [London Is a Collision](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/london-is-a-collision): Suchitra Harsha, Sep 8, 2026. Three weeks in a city I had written off. Windows, facades and interiors, and why the master plan is a myth: a city lives and dies in its joints and details.
- [Designing for a Billion: 5 Ways India’s New Building Code is Reimagining the Modern City](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/designing-for-a-billion-5-ways-india-s-new-building-code-is-reimagining-the-modern-city): Paromita Harsha, Apr 16, 2026. India’s urban population is projected to reach 820 million by 2051. How the National Building Code 2016 is rethinking our cities at scale.
- [Architecture That Teaches: The Reality of Designing Modern Educational Spaces](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/architecture-that-teaches-the-reality-of-designing-modern-educational-spaces): Kumar and Swamy Architects, Apr 8, 2026. Physical space is a silent partner in every classroom. Notes on the real-world challenges and rewards of designing modern educational spaces.
- [Inclusivity in Architecture — Design Without Bias](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/inclusivity-in-architecture-design-without-bias): Varun Govind, Aug 7, 2025. Building spaces that work in a fragmented world — a practical philosophy for bias-free, inclusive design.
- [18th June, 2025: An Architect’s Journal Entry](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/18th-june-2025-an-architect-s-journal-entry): Prathik R. Jagtap, Jun 18, 2025. A monsoon-morning time-slip to 1995 — drafting tables, ammonia prints and scale models, and a reflection on what architecture felt like before the screens.
- [Designing Flexible and Adaptable Learning Spaces](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/designing-flexible-and-adaptable-learning-spaces): Kumar and Swamy Architects, May 22, 2025. Movable furniture, zoned spaces and technology hubs — how reconfigurable learning environments support diverse teaching methods and active learning.
- [The Impact of Colour on Learning: A Guide to Selecting Colours for School Interiors](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/the-impact-of-colour-on-learning-a-guide-to-selecting-colours-for-school-interiors): Kumar and Swamy Architects, Jan 28, 2025. Warm, cool and neutral palettes, colour-coding and wayfinding — a practical guide to using colour to support focus, identity and learning in schools.
- [Vivitsa World School: The Architecture](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/vivitsa-world-school-the-architecture): Kumar and Swamy Architects, Dec 6, 2024. A child-centric, courtyard-based campus where every brick serves a pedagogical purpose — learning, play and nature woven into a sustainable design.
- [The Importance of Natural Light in School Design](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/the-importance-of-natural-light-in-school-design): Kumar and Swamy Architects, Nov 21, 2024. Why daylight matters in Indian schools — its measurable effect on performance, health and mood, and the strategies we use to bring it deep into buildings.
- [50 Years of Kumar & Swamy](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/50-years-of-kumar-swamy): Kumar and Swamy Architects, Oct 11, 2022. We marked our 50th anniversary with an Open Day — old hand-drafted drawings, CR Shivakumar’s legacy, and friends from across Bangalore.
- [Reinterpreting Our Very First School](https://kumarandswamyarchitects.com/post/reinterpreting-our-very-first-school): Kumar and Swamy Architects, Feb 11, 2021. Thirty years on, we extended Mallya Aditi — our very first school — with a lightweight steel structure that reinterprets the original in a modern context.
